text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once again, the Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every year, this event gives Umamusume and 
their fans a chance to interact through 
sports-day-like festivities, but—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—A pop-up event!! Produced by 
Golshi-chan!! The Extra-Large Golden Fan 
Appreciation Fest~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ya wanna go to Planet Golshi~~?! Is that 
so, is that so~~?! Well in that case, give 
it everything you've got, you guys♪

text_block_list.name: Ruck's Inner Voice & Meno
text_block_list.text:
(I don't get this at aaaaaaall!!!) I don't 
understand what's going on, sirrr!!???

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Just what do you think you're doing, sir! 
Pulling off an act that's practically a 
takeover...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Mame-chin, entertainment evolves every 
day, ya know? Sort yesterday's common 
sense into the trash and chuck it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And so, the first battle is Mame-chin vs. 
Lara! All you folks in the audience, get 
hypeee!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: When did so many fans gather here...?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Fenomeno-san. Let's just play along 
quietly with Golshi-san's antics for now.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"The fans are having a great time too, and 
that in itself is a good thing, so..."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, understood...! However, personally, 
you will be receiving a strict warning 
later...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The first battle is an Ogiri comedy 
contest! Here's the prompt, bam! 'What is 
Golshi-chan's most recent dilemma?'

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, an ogiri contest?! Well that 
changes everything...!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I gotta answer while keepin' up that 
super refined image, which makes this way 
harder...! Uh, let's see—)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Mame-chin, you're fast! Hit me with a 
funny answer! "What is Golshi-chan's 
latest worry?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
To be frank, I'm just not feeling it and 
cannot train, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Th-That's just a normal answer--!!! This 
is supposed to be an ogiri comedy bit, you 
know--?!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Listen here, Mame-chin!! You really 
think!! You can conquer the world with me 
like that?!! BAM, minus one hundred 
million Golshi Points!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Lala, you're up next! Show 'em 
how it's done!!! "What is Golshi-chan's 
latest worry?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm... I'm debating whether to change 
the intonation of 'Golshi-chan' to 
'Gol→shi↑-chan↓'.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, crap. On the spot, this was all I 
could come up with—)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: H-Hey, Lala... Are you... psychic...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
For guessin' what was botherin' 
Golshi-chan this mornin', you get a 
special one hundred million points!! This 
battle goes to Lala!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(This ain't even a comedy bit 
anymore!!!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"The next battle is Nakayama VS Lala!! 
We'll settle this with a game of Pop-up 
Golshi!!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... So, you stab swords into the 
barrel with the Golshi doll inside, and 
whoever hits the switch that makes her pop 
out loses, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's simple, but it's a high-stakes match. 
Are you ready, Lara?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
If I'm doing this, I'm giving it 
everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, big words. In that case, I'll show 
you what a real match is all about.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, Golshi! Are we only allowed to stick 
one sword in per turn?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nn-noope. It's an all-you-can-stab buffet 
for your heart's desire~♪

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! Then my first move is 
sticking in 10 swords at once...!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: A-Are you serious... !?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"It's the risk that gets you fired up...! 
Here comes round one!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Stab!!) (POOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOP!!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-chan FLY AWAAAY!!! Nakayama 
LOOOOSES!!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... That's all part of the game 
too, huh...! Splendidly done, Lara.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I didn't even do anything, 
seriously!!!!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, it's time for the 
final battle!! For the finale, these folks 
are joining the judging panel!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Do not spoil my amusement.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I wonder what kind of 
interesting things I'll get to see~.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And the battle isss~~! "Do something 
funny"! Alright, go ahead!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(This topic is way too vague!!! You trust 
us way too much!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...With excitement running this high, we 
can't just brush it aside, can we?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I'll go first, then. An impression of 
Golshi-san suddenly asking a fan a bizarre 
question.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "Hey, you..."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Do you prefer chocolate fondue over sauce 
on your yakisoba?"

text_block_list.name: Laughter
text_block_list.text: (Thud!)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, sounds just like you~! Not bad, 
Journey!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh...—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Niiice! Thanks to you, the whole venue's 
buzzing with warmth!! As expected of 
someone who really gets entertainment!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Th-That's cheeeeeeaaating!!! If 
Journey-san does that, of course it's 
gonna be hilarious!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Lara, what're you gonna do?! 
What've you got for us?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Aargh, if that's how it's gonna be, I'm 
ridin' this wave too!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well then... my impression of Golshi-san 
when she suddenly started teaching me all 
sorts of things.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Hey Lara-chan, you know what? A hamburger 
steak is, like――"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
“—You can still make it without onions, 
y'know.”

text_block_list.name: Laughter
text_block_list.text: (Thud!)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! That totally sounds like something 
they'd say~!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Fufu...—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Both of 'em are doing pretty damn 
good...!! Looks like the judges' reactions 
are dead even!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's leave the verdict to 
the audience!! C'mon, let's hear those 
upvotes, peopleeee!!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
“As expected of Dream Journey~!” 
“Lala-chan did great too!” “Journey-sama, 
you were magnificent!!”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hmm-mm-mm. According to the Gold Ship Ear 
tally—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“The winner by a narrow margin is 
Journey!! *drumroll* Ta-daaa~!!”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm just glad everyone seemed to 
enjoy themselves.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Ghhk...! That's a bit frustrating...! 
Still, I somehow managed to survive this 
chaotic event...!!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now that our very first champion has been 
decided—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The 2nd Extra-Large Golden Fan 
Appreciation Festival!! Let's get this 
party started~~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Wait, when is this ever gonna eeeend?!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Golden Extra-Large Fan 
Appreciation Festival repeated all day 
long, and Lucky Lilac continued to fight 
her hardest—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Lara-chan did great!" "That was so fun!" 
"So glad we got to see an unexpected side 
of her!!" "Holding her own against that 
lineup is amazing!!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(H-Huh...? Are a lot of people talking 
about me...!?)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hmm-mm-mm. According to the Gold Ship Ear 
tally—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“The winner is Lala!! This year's No. 1 
Umamusume of Golshi Planets is none other 
than yooouuuu!!!”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Miss Lala. That was truly 
splendid.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I never thought I'd 
actually win...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well now, you held your own quite well 
against Journey and the others, didn't 
you? Good job, good job.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! Um, I somehow managed to pull 
through...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...It served as a fine way to pass the 
time.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...! Hearing you say that makes me so 
happy...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Whoaaa!! Everyone gave me so much 
praise!! I-I'm honestly so happy...!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
As our very first champion, Lala will 
receive a prize later! A half-day's worth 
of scrubbing brushes!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(What do you mean, "half a day's worth of 
tawashi scrubbers"!?!? Are they so 
fleeting that they just suddenly vanish 
into thin air after half a day!?)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"And from here on out, it's the 2nd Golden 
Extra-Large Fan Appreciation Festival, 
baybeee!!!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
All right, guess I'll join in from here. 
Everyone, let's have some fun~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Wait, when is this ever gonna eeeend?!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Golden Extra-Large Fan 
Appreciation Festival repeated all day 
long, and Lucky Lilac continued to fight 
hard as the champion—
